facts.fact: UN News, citing the OHCHR spokesperson, reports that the six journalists of the fact-checking website Matsadash remained in detention on 10 November 2026, with OHCHR calling for charges arising from their journalistic work to be dropped.
UN News reports that in October 2026 an Egyptian court convicted Mada Masr editor Lina Attalah of operating an unlicensed website, fined her and ordered the website closed.
